list_customers.title: List customers
list_customers.description: Page through the company's customers with their unique ids, names and emails, optionally filtered by name. Use get_customer for full details and list_customer_subscriptions for what they are subscribed to.

search.description: Only customers whose name contains this text.

results.description: Customers with customerUniqueId, firstName, lastName, email and status.

get_customer.title: Get a customer
get_customer.description: Read one customer: name, email, billing address, phone, marketing consent, card status, total paid and average monthly revenue.

create_customer.title: Create a customer
create_customer.description: Create a customer without a subscription, optionally with a tokenized payment card. To sign someone up to a plan in one step use create_subscription instead; to add a plan later use add_subscription_to_customer.

state.description: Billing address state or region; for US addresses the two-letter state code.

country.description: Billing address country as an ISO 3166 three-letter code, e.g. USA, GBR.

card_token.description: Payment card token from Billsby's card tokenizer (the create token call of the checkout JS library); raw card numbers are never accepted.

card_type.description: Card brand, e.g. visa, master, american_express.

card_last4.description: Last four digits of the card.

update_customer.title: Update a customer
update_customer.description: Change a customer's name, email, phone number or billing address. Only the fields supplied are sent. Use update_payment_card to change their card.

phone_dial_country.description: Phone dial country, e.g. US or UK.

state.description: Billing address state or region; for US addresses the two-letter state code.

country.description: Billing address country as an ISO 3166 three-letter code, e.g. USA, GBR.

delete_customer.title: Delete a customer
delete_customer.description: Delete a customer from Billsby. Cancel their subscriptions first with cancel_subscription; to anonymise instead of delete use clear_customer_personal_data.

clear_customer_personal_data.title: Clear customer data (GDPR)
clear_customer_personal_data.description: Erase a customer's personal data for a GDPR request, keeping anonymised billing records. Irreversible.

list_customer_subscriptions.title: List a customer's subscriptions
list_customer_subscriptions.description: List every subscription a customer has, with product, plan, status, currency, revenue and next billing date.

get_customer_feature_tags.title: Get a customer's feature tags
get_customer_feature_tags.description: List the feature tags across all of a customer's subscriptions, the quickest way to check what a customer is entitled to.

request_payment_details_update.title: Request updated payment details
request_payment_details_update.description: Email the customer a request to update their payment card, e.g. after a failed payment. Use update_payment_card when you already hold a new card token.
request_payment_details_update.notes: A GET by the provider's design, so it is marked read-only, but it sends the customer an email.

update_payment_card.title: Update a payment card
update_payment_card.description: Replace a customer's stored payment card with a new card token from Billsby's tokenizer.

card_token.description: Payment card token from Billsby's card tokenizer (the create token call of the checkout JS library); raw card numbers are never accepted.

card_type.description: Card brand, e.g. visa, master, american_express.

card_last4.description: Last four digits of the card.

create_one_time_charge.title: Create a one-time charge
create_one_time_charge.description: Bill a customer a one-off amount outside their subscription; Billsby raises an invoice and charges their card.

amount.description: Amount in the currency's minor units, e.g. 1000 for 10.00.

description.description: What the charge is for; shown on the invoice.

output.description: true when the charge was created.

list_invoices.title: List invoices
list_invoices.description: Page through all of the company's invoices, searchable and filterable by status (pending, paid, unpaid, paid offline, written off). Use list_customer_invoices for one customer.

query.description: Search terms, e.g. an invoice number, customer name or email.

order_by.description: Property to sort by, e.g. CreatedOn.

order_by_descending.description: Property to sort by in descending order, e.g. CreatedOn.

results.description: Invoices with invoiceNumber, customer, amount, currency and status.

list_customer_invoices.title: List a customer's invoices
list_customer_invoices.description: List every invoice of one customer with number, date, amount, refundable amount, currency and status.

get_invoice.title: Get an invoice
get_invoice.description: Read one invoice by number: customer, billing address, line items, taxes, totals, status and payment details.
get_invoice.notes: Billsby's reference shows this path without the company domain segment; the pack sends it under the company domain like every other core endpoint.

list_invoice_payment_logs.title: List invoice payment logs
list_invoice_payment_logs.description: List the payment attempts made against a customer's invoice: gateway, reference, method and status of each. Useful for diagnosing a failed payment.

refund_invoice.title: Refund an invoice
refund_invoice.description: Refund all or part of a paid invoice to the customer's card; amounts are in minor units (100 = 1.00). Money leaves your account, so confirm first.

amount.description: Amount to refund in minor units, e.g. 100 for 1.00; may be partial.

retry_invoice_payment.title: Retry an invoice payment
retry_invoice_payment.description: Attempt to collect an unpaid invoice again from the customer's card on file.

mark_invoice_paid_offline.title: Mark an invoice paid offline
mark_invoice_paid_offline.description: Record that an unpaid invoice was settled outside Billsby (cash, bank transfer), so it is no longer chased.

write_off_invoice.title: Write off an invoice
write_off_invoice.description: Write off an unpaid invoice as uncollectable so Billsby stops trying to collect it.

list_credit_notes.title: List credit notes
list_credit_notes.description: Page through all of the company's credit notes (refunds and credits), searchable and filterable by pending, paid or failed status.

query.description: Search terms, e.g. a credit note number or customer name.

order_by.description: Property to sort by, e.g. CreatedOn.

order_by_descending.description: Property to sort by in descending order.

results.description: Credit notes with number, customer, amount and status.

list_customer_credit_notes.title: List a customer's credit notes
list_customer_credit_notes.description: List every credit note issued to one customer with number, date, amount, currency and status.

retry_credit_note_payment.title: Retry a credit note payment
retry_credit_note_payment.description: Retry paying out a failed credit note (refund) to the customer's card.

list_subscriptions.title: List subscriptions
list_subscriptions.description: Page through all subscriptions with their unique ids, customer, product, plan and status, filtered by active or free-trial state or product/plan name and sorted by any property.

order_by.description: Subscription property to sort by, e.g. CreatedOn.

order_by_descending.description: Property to sort by, newest/highest first, e.g. CreatedOn.

is_in_free_trial.description: Only subscriptions in a free trial.

product_name.description: Only subscriptions to products with this name.

plan_name.description: Only subscriptions on plans with this name.

results.description: Subscriptions with subscriptionUniqueID, customerUniqueId, product, plan and status.

get_subscription.title: Get a subscription
get_subscription.description: Read one subscription: customer, product, plan, cycle, status, currency, price, next billing date, contract term and trial details.

create_subscription.title: Create a customer and subscription
create_subscription.description: Sign up a new customer to a plan cycle in one call, with billing address, tokenized card and optional add-ons, allowances, coupons and custom field answers. For an existing customer use add_subscription_to_customer. Returns both new ids.

cycle_id.description: Plan cycle to subscribe to (see list_plans; each plan lists its cycles).

state.description: Billing address state or region; for US addresses the two-letter state code.

country.description: Billing address country as an ISO 3166 three-letter code, e.g. USA, GBR.

card_token.description: Payment card token from Billsby's card tokenizer (the create token call of the checkout JS library); raw card numbers are never accepted.

card_type.description: Card brand, e.g. visa, master, american_express.

card_last4.description: Last four digits of the card.

shipping_address_line_1.description: Shipping address, if different from billing, line 1.

shipping_address_line_2.description: Shipping address, if different from billing, line 2.

shipping_city.description: Shipping address, if different from billing, city.

shipping_state.description: Shipping address, if different from billing, state or region; for US addresses the two-letter state code.

shipping_country.description: Shipping address, if different from billing, country as an ISO 3166 three-letter code, e.g. USA, GBR.

shipping_post_code.description: Shipping address, if different from billing, postal code.

additional_email.description: An additional email address for the customer.

phone_dial_country.description: Country of the phone number, e.g. US or UK (required with phone_number).

phone_dial_code.description: Dial code of the phone number, e.g. 1 or 44 (required with phone_number).

marketing_consent.description: Whether the customer gave marketing consent.

add_ons.description: Add-ons to include: [{"addOnId": 3, "quantity": 2}] (quantity for unit-based add-ons).

add_subscription_to_customer.title: Add a subscription to a customer
add_subscription_to_customer.description: Subscribe an existing customer to a plan cycle, charging their card on file. Per the reference the customer must not already have a plan on their account.

cycle_id.description: Plan cycle to subscribe to (see list_plans).

state.description: Billing address state or region; for US addresses the two-letter state code.

country.description: Billing address country as an ISO 3166 three-letter code, e.g. USA, GBR.

shipping_state.description: Shipping address state or region; for US addresses the two-letter state code.

shipping_country.description: Shipping address country as an ISO 3166 three-letter code, e.g. USA, GBR.

ip_address.description: Customer's IP address, for tax evidence.

additional_email.description: An additional email address for the customer.

phone_dial_country.description: Country of the phone number, e.g. US or UK (required with phone_number).

phone_dial_code.description: Dial code of the phone number, e.g. 1 or 44 (required with phone_number).

marketing_consent.description: Whether the customer gave marketing consent.

add_ons.description: Add-ons to include: [{"addOnId": 3, "quantity": 2}] (quantity for unit-based add-ons).

change_subscription_plan.title: Change a subscription's plan
change_subscription_plan.description: Move a subscription to another plan and cycle, immediately (optionally refunding the prorated remainder) or at renewal, with new units, add-ons and allowances.

change_type.description: When the change applies: 1 immediately (default), 2 at the next renewal.

units.description: Units on the new plan (unit-based cycles).

allowances.description: Allowance ids for the new plan.

issue_refund.description: For an immediate change, credit the prorated unused amount of the current plan to the first new invoice.

cancel_subscription.title: Cancel a subscription
cancel_subscription.description: Cancel a customer's subscription so it stops renewing. Cannot be undone; to stop billing temporarily use update_renewal_date with pause.

update_renewal_date.title: Change the next renewal date or pause
update_renewal_date.description: Move a subscription's next renewal date, optionally pausing it until then. This is Billsby's way to pause and later resume billing.

new_renewal_date.description: New next renewal date, ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-11-01T00:00:00Z.

pause.description: Pause the subscription until the new renewal date.

get_subscription_shipping_address.title: Get a subscription's shipping address
get_subscription_shipping_address.description: Read the shipping address stored on a subscription.

update_subscription_shipping_address.title: Update a subscription's shipping address
update_subscription_shipping_address.description: Replace the shipping address stored on a subscription.

state.description: Shipping address state or region; for US addresses the two-letter state code.

country.description: Shipping address country as an ISO 3166 three-letter code, e.g. USA, GBR.

list_subscription_event_logs.title: List subscription event logs
list_subscription_event_logs.description: Page through a subscription's event history (created, plan changes, payments, cancellations) with event data, for auditing what happened and when.

results.description: Events with subscriptionEventLogId, type, createdOn and eventData.

list_subscription_add_ons.title: List a subscription's add-ons
list_subscription_add_ons.description: List the add-ons on a subscription with quantity, next quantity, status and whether each is forced by the plan.

list_subscription_allowances.title: List a subscription's allowances
list_subscription_allowances.description: List the usage allowances on a subscription with included units, current usage and status.

list_subscription_feature_tags.title: List a subscription's feature tags
list_subscription_feature_tags.description: List every feature tag on a subscription (from its plan, add-ons and custom tags), for entitlement checks. Use get_subscription_feature_tags_split to tell plan tags from custom ones.

get_subscription_feature_tags_split.title: Get feature tags by source
get_subscription_feature_tags_split.description: List a subscription's feature tags split into those coming from the plan and custom tags added to the subscription.

add_feature_tag.title: Add a feature tag
add_feature_tag.description: Add a custom feature tag to one or more subscriptions, e.g. to grant an extra entitlement.

subscription_ids.description: Subscription unique ids to tag, comma-separated.

delete_feature_tag.title: Remove a feature tag
delete_feature_tag.description: Remove a custom feature tag from a subscription. Tags that come from the plan cannot be removed this way.

subscription_id.description: Subscription unique id to remove it from.

get_counter_value.title: Get a usage counter
get_counter_value.description: Read the usage recorded on a subscription's counter (the meter behind a usage allowance), optionally between two dates.

counter_id.description: The counter id (from the allowance's counter, see get_allowance).

from.description: Start of the period, ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-08-01T00:00:00.000Z.

update_counter.title: Record usage on a counter
update_counter.description: Increment, decrement or set a subscription's usage counter, which drives usage-based allowance billing.

counter_id.description: The counter id (from the allowance's counter, see get_allowance).

list_products.title: List products
list_products.description: Page through the company's products with ids, names, currency and visibility, optionally filtered by name or visibility. Use list_plans for a product's plans.

search.description: Only products whose name contains this text.

visibility.description: Visibility: 0 public, 1 hidden, 2 internal, 3 off sale.

results.description: Products with productId, name, displayName, billingCurrency and visibility.

get_product.title: Get a product
get_product.description: Read one product with its checkout settings, currency, visibility and country limitations.

create_product.title: Create a product
create_product.description: Create a product (what you sell), with currency, visibility and checkout settings. Add plans with create_plan and pricing with create_cycles.

visibility.description: Visibility: 0 public, 1 hidden, 2 internal, 3 off sale.

is_shipping_address_required.description: Collect a shipping address at checkout.

is_additional_email_required.description: Collect an additional email at checkout.

is_phone_number_required.description: Collect a phone number at checkout.

is_marketing_consent_required.description: Ask for marketing consent at checkout.

alert_email.description: Email alerted when someone signs up to this product.

update_product.title: Update a product
update_product.description: Change a product's names, description, currency, visibility or checkout settings.

visibility.description: Visibility: 0 public, 1 hidden, 2 internal, 3 off sale.

is_shipping_address_required.description: Collect a shipping address at checkout.

is_additional_email_required.description: Collect an additional email at checkout.

is_phone_number_required.description: Collect a phone number at checkout.

is_marketing_consent_required.description: Ask for marketing consent at checkout.

alert_email.description: Email alerted when someone signs up to this product.

list_plans.title: List plans
list_plans.description: List a product's plans with their pricing model, feature tags, visibility and cycles (the cycle ids create_subscription takes).

create_plan.title: Create a plan
create_plan.description: Create a plan under a product with a pricing model (1 flat fee, 2 per unit, 3 reserved, 4 tiered, 5 volume, 6 ranged). Add its billing cycles with create_cycles.

feature_tags.description: Feature tags granted by the plan, comma-separated.

visibility.description: Visibility: 0 public, 1 hidden, 2 internal, 3 off sale.

redirect_url.description: URL customers go to after checkout.

alert_email.description: Email alerted on sign-ups to this plan.

pricing_model.description: Pricing model: 1 FlatFee, 2 PerUnit, 3 Reserved, 4 Tiered, 5 Volume, 6 Ranged.

update_plan.title: Update a plan and its cycles
update_plan.description: Change a plan's names, description, feature tags, visibility, redirect or alert email, and optionally its cycles' pricing.

feature_tags.description: Feature tags granted by the plan, comma-separated.

visibility.description: Visibility: 0 public, 1 hidden, 2 internal, 3 off sale.

redirect_url.description: URL customers go to after checkout.

alert_email.description: Email alerted on sign-ups to this plan.

cycles.description: Cycle changes: cycleId plus frequency, frequencyType (1 daily, 2 weekly, 3 monthly, 4 yearly), price (minor units), freeTrial, freeTrialFrequencyType, setupFeePrice, billingDateType, proRateOption, visibility and tiers.

update_plan_order.title: Reorder plans
update_plan_order.description: Set the order a product's plans are displayed in at checkout.

plan_ids.description: All plan ids in the desired order.

create_cycles.title: Create plan cycles
create_cycles.description: Add billing cycles (price and frequency) to a plan, with optional attached add-ons and allowances. Prices are in minor units.

cycles.description: Cycles, each with frequency, frequencyType (1 daily, 2 weekly, 3 monthly, 4 yearly), price, billingDateType (1 anniversary, 2 fixed day of month, 3 fixed day of week), visibility (0-3) and optional freeTrial, freeTrialFrequencyType, contractTerm, contractTermFrequencyType, setupFeePrice, freeQuantity, fixedBillingDateDay, fixedBillingDateMonth, proRateOption (1-3) and tiers [{start, finish, price}].

add_ons.description: Add-ons to attach: [{addonId, isForced, addonPriceModels: [{currencyIso3Code, frequency, frequencyType, flatFeePrice, pricePerUnit, unitTiers}]}]. Send [] for none.

allowances.description: Allowances to attach: [{allowanceId, isForced, allowancePriceModels: [{currencyIso3Code, frequency, frequencyType, includedUnits, pricePerUnit, unitTiers}]}].

list_add_ons.title: List add-ons
list_add_ons.description: List the company's add-ons (optional extras attached to plans) with ids, names and whether they are linked to active plans.

get_add_on.title: Get an add-on
get_add_on.description: Read one add-on with its unit names, pricing model, feature tags, linked plans and price models.

list_allowances.title: List allowances
list_allowances.description: List the company's usage allowances (metered entitlements attached to plans) with ids and names.

get_allowance.title: Get an allowance
get_allowance.description: Read one allowance with its counter (the counter id get_counter_value takes), pricing model, feature tags, linked plans and price models.

list_custom_fields.title: List custom fields
list_custom_fields.description: List the custom checkout fields defined for the company, with id, type, label, options and whether compulsory.

create_custom_field.title: Create a custom field
create_custom_field.description: Define a new custom field to collect at checkout.

type.description: Field type: 0 single-line text, 1 multi-line text, 2 checkbox, 3 date picker, 4 number, 5 dropdown.

update_custom_field.title: Update a custom field
update_custom_field.description: Change a custom field's label, description, dropdown options or compulsory flag.

list_custom_field_responses.title: List custom field responses
list_custom_field_responses.description: List customers' answers to custom fields, optionally for one customer or product; each answer carries the customFieldResponseId update_custom_field_response takes.

customer_id.description: Only this customer's answers (customer unique id).

output.description: Responses with the field and value.

update_custom_field_response.title: Update a custom field response
update_custom_field_response.description: Change a customer's answer to a custom field.
